newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto EPS view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc on Friday said it lowered its earnings estimates on Discount Auto Parts Inc to $1.50 a share from $1.57 for fiscal 1997, and to $1.67 from $1.87 for FY98.
-- The firm said it lowered its estimates on an expectation of flat to slightly lower gross margins, higher legal expenses and higher interest expense.
-- Discount Auto is named in a lawsuit alleging fraudulent sale of freon, and it does not expect resolution until at least the end of summer, EVEREN noted in a report.
